about.title: About
about.p1: Passionate frontend developer with a strong focus on JavaScript, TypeScript and React. I care about building clean, efficient, well-tested software that delivers real value.
about.p2: Outside of code, I enjoy spending quality time with my family, swimming, playing squash, reading manga and diving into video games.
about.p3: My work is split between two GitHub accounts: noofreuuuh for my personal projects and smouillour for my professional contributions at Qlik.

projects.title: Projects
projects.sebastien-lemouillour-fr: The source code of this personal website — built with React and the Lufa Design System.
projects.lufa-design-system: A React design system with semantic tokens, supporting dark/light mode. Includes interactive Storybook documentation.
projects.lufa-lab: Experimental playground for new ideas in the Lufa workspace.
projects.bmad-manager: BMad agent manager to automate development workflows.
projects.lufa-core: Shared infrastructure for the Lufa ecosystem: ESLint/Prettier/TypeScript configs, autobuild CDN, and POC experiments.
projects.dotfiles: Personal configuration: terminal, aliases and development environment.
projects.leetcode: My LeetCode solutions — algorithmic practice in JavaScript.
projects.git-dashboard: Dashboard for visualizing Git repositories and activity.
projects.spark-ai-app-generator: AI application generator — Spark experiment in TypeScript.
projects.spark-token-dependency-vis: Design token dependency visualizer — Spark experiment in TypeScript.
projects.spark-pixel-art-converter: Pixel art converter — Spark experiment in TypeScript.
projects.poc-phaser: Proof of concept game in Vue.js with the Phaser engine.
projects.poc-bot-discord: Experimental Discord bot (Grabot) — JavaScript proof of concept.
projects.dashboard: Dashboard for managing GitHub, Jira and other tools from a single interface.
projects.annuaire-musees: Museum directory (PHP backend + JavaScript frontend) — one of my first web projects.
projects.model-passportjs-init: SailJS template with PassportJS for authentication — MVC architecture reference.
